title: Tower of Justice, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Tower of Justice (Adalet Kulesi) only, fifth authored member of18 required Topkapi Palace structures. Square pale masonry shaft with real recessed barred windows, corbelled projecting balcony and muted glazed railing, taller four-sided belvedere with arched recessed glazing and eight paired corner shafts, segmental curved pediments, closed curved roof shoulders, steep square lead pyramid and small gold finial. Council Hall/attached portico, Harem and Outer Treasury remain independent. No invented clock, furnished stair/interior, exact sculptural carving, copied inscriptions, visitors or transient CCTV/maintenance equipment.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Individual Q20470393 and OSM way335402653/native35184707491485. The particular approximately8.7x8.6m quadrilateral shaft footprint fixes the anchor/scale and is distinct from the adjacent Council Hall, attached portico and Harem. Native+X east/+Z south at heading0. Internal+X follows the palace wall north-northeast; internal+Z faces the Second Courtyard east-southeast. Both ordinary photographs show the same stone shaft, high arched lookout, segmental pediments and narrow lead pyramid; the2026 image informs the current balcony glazing.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No qualified height is supplied by this standard-map parent. Picture-led working shaft16m, projecting balcony16.0-16.55m, glazed belvedere17.35-25.4m, pediment crowns about28m, square lead spire25.9-36.5m and finial37.9m. Upper window clear width3.1m; paired slender shafts rise17-24.7m. These heights, exact lower-window inventory, pane grids, corbel/capital profiles and roof seams are approximate visualization proportions, not surveyed dimensions, structural/current-condition or accessibility certification. Roof silhouette and the distinctive upper window/column/pediment arrangement guide recognition. No clock is introduced.
